name: Laurasian Wolf
journal_prompt: A grey wolf of the northern steppe crosses the dry grass at a steady trot, head low, going somewhere it has been before.
appearance: A lean grey wolf of the steppe, its coat grizzled grey and tawny, paler at the throat and along the legs, with a dark-tipped bushy tail and amber eyes.
notes: The wolf of Mainland Asia, met only on the Aravali's northern shore. Jambhudweep's own wolf is the plateau wolf; the strait keeps them apart.
